name: dsh-auth-gateway
description: Password login gateway plugin for dsh web: auto-generated initial password with forced onboarding, login, password change with real request interception, and OTP two-factor authentication.

scripts.build:check: npm run build:client && git diff --exit-code -- client/index.js client/index.js.map
scripts.test: node --test --test-force-exit tests/gateway.test.mjs tests/config.test.mjs tests/policy.test.mjs tests/plugin-contract.test.mjs tests/patch-ports.test.mjs tests/client-contract.test.mjs tests/otp.test.mjs tests/locale.test.mjs
